summary: Iteration 152: Workspace module and Multi-device linking features fully tested. All 23 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified working: Workspace page with 5 tabs (Pinned, My Tickets, Watched, Scratchpad, Recent), metric strip (4 tiles), pin/unpin functionality, scratchpad notes persistence. Ticket detail shows Pin toggle in Actions menu, Pinned badge, and Linked Devices chip-list component with add/remove/promote functionality.

issues: Console warnings about duplicate tiptap extensions (link, underline) - cosmetic only, not affecting functionality

Multi-device linking correctly handles primary device promotion when unlinking
All data-testid attributes present for testing: ws-tab-*, ws-stat-*, ws-scratch-textarea, ws-save-notes, ticket-linked-devices, link-device-*, actions-pin
